IDENT.title: Agentic Manufacturing Operations Management: Concept and First Prototype

A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.value: No explicit definition; MAS described as control distributed through multiple autonomous agents that make local decisions and coordinate.
A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.evidence_quote: control is distributed through multiple autonomous agents that make local decisions and coordinate with each other

A_DEFINITION__agent_term_used.evidence_quote: a prototype in which large language-enabled agents support the design of experiments process

A_DEFINITION__agent_entity_types.evidence_quote: The eight core MOM activities, product definition, resource management, scheduling, dispatching, execution management, data collection, tracking and performance analysis are reinterpreted as autonomous agents

B_ARCHITECTURE__has_knowledge_base.evidence_quote: The Digital Twin Plane provides the semantic foundation for agents

B_ARCHITECTURE__decision_mechanism.evidence_quote: LM Studio is used for hosting the LLM model (Llama-3.3-70b) through an OpenAI-compatible API interface.

B_ARCHITECTURE__has_communication_manage.evidence_quote: with an orchestration layer coordinating interactions and an agent registry ensuring role discoverability

B_ARCHITECTURE__implementation_platform.evidence_quote: The workflow of agents and between agents are defined through LangGraph.

C_MEMORY__memory_realtime.evidence_quote: The Production Tracking Agent monitors and directs shop floor resource operations via the digital twin environment.

C_MEMORY__memory_update_mechanism.evidence_quote: viscosity and homogeneity are captured and synced with the Product Digital Twin

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_protocol.evidence_quote: Prompts for defining the ‘tool use’ leveraging the Asset Administration Shell (AAS) on the digital twin environment.

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_topology.evidence_quote: with an orchestration layer coordinating interactions

E_LEARNING__uses_foundation_model.evidence_quote: LM Studio is used for hosting the LLM model (Llama-3.3-70b)

E_LEARNING__foundation_model_role.evidence_quote: ChainLit is used for enabling user interaction through a conversational interface.

E_LEARNING__foundation_model_limitations.value: High computational demands (42.52GB memory footprint); substantial effort for guardrails and prompt engineering to ensure reliability.
E_LEARNING__foundation_model_limitations.evidence_quote: high computational demands due to the need for LLMs with large memory footprints (42.52GB)

F_DT_COUPLING__dt_present_in_work.evidence_quote: The Digital Twin Plane uses the Eclipse BaSyx AAS framework for digital representations.

F_DT_COUPLING__agent_dt_coupling.evidence_quote: These serve as shared representations of manufacturing entities, allowing agents to reason about capabilities, constraints, and performance.

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__validation_level.evidence_quote: This data is coming in the demonstration from equipment emulators that replicate recorded data from actual runs.

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__metrics_reported.evidence_quote: the complete workflow was accomplished in just 45% of the time it would take a human to manually input data

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__baseline_compared_.evidence_quote: 45% of the time it would take a human to manually input data into the system

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__system_scale.evidence_quote: The Production Definition Agent specifies production routes and recipes. The Production Tracking Agent monitors

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__application_domain.evidence_quote: slurry mixing experimentation scenario for lithium-ion battery production

H_STANDARDS__standards_referenced.evidence_quote: This architecture builds on the ISO/IEC 62264-3 activity model

H_STANDARDS__interoperability_claimed.evidence_quote: enables semantic interoperability across heterogeneous systems without the need to implement multiple custom integration mechanisms

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_common_wi.evidence_quote: Agents interact with these systems through adapters and services, ensuring operational continuity.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.value: Agents represent ISA-95 MOM activities (not parts/resources), LLM-driven via LangGraph orchestration, overlay on legacy MES, AAS digital twin plane; no negotiation or capability-based planning.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.evidence_quote: positions agents as an overlay layer that adds adaptivity, autonomy, and integration without requiring system replacement

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__static_vs_dynamic_.evidence_quote: The workflow of agents and between agents are defined through LangGraph.
